notes: Field trial at Kadomba (Houet, Burkina Faso), 2020, RCBD, 4 reps: biochar from invasive aquatic plants (5 t/ha, alone or mixed), biochar + poultry manure, NPK 150 kg/ha, vs no-input control. Only biochar/manure chemistry and maize growth parameters to 37-40 days after sowing (height, collar diameter, leaf number); no yield. The abstract and conclusion say IAP biochar 'has a lower operational cost than other fertilizers', but no cost, price, return or other economic value is given anywhere; no adoption or carbon income data. Biochar itself qualifies (feedstock stated, cone kiln), so the paper fails only on outcome data.
